config.polymer-patch-bundle.detailed_sma: Draws Terrestria's small oak logs, such as the canyon's bryce trees, at their real size. Turn this off if the game runs slowly near them.
config.polymer-patch-bundle.detailed_sak: Draws sakura trunks and branches at their real size. Sakura forests hold thousands of them, so this costs a lot of frame rate.
config.polymer-patch-bundle.detailed_yuc: Draws yucca palm trunks at their real size. Turn this off if the game runs slowly near them.
config.polymer-patch-bundle.detailed_sag: Draws saguaro cacti with their arms at their real size, instead of a plain cactus column.
